description: Parse a Content-Security-Policy, explain each directive and flag weaknesses (unsafe-inline, wildcards, missing object-src/base-uri/frame-ancestors…). Operations: "evaluate" — Parse a CSP header and return its directives and findings by severity.; "harden" — Add the low-risk directives a policy is missing (object-src 'none', base-uri, frame-ancestors, form-action) and return ready-to-paste header, meta, nginx and Apache forms.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: evaluate: A CSP header value (optionally with the "Content-Security-Policy:" name). harden: A CSP header value.

operation.description: evaluate — Parse a CSP header and return its directives and findings by severity. harden — Add the low-risk directives a policy is missing (object-src 'none', base-uri, frame-ancestors, form-action) and return ready-to-paste header, meta, nginx and Apache forms.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

name: csp
title: CSP Evaluator
